adm_nav_home_text:
⚙️ Admin panel
Choose a section below. Use “Back to main menu” to leave.
adm_nav_addpanel_text:
🖥 Add panel
Use the secure web form to add a panel and its connection credentials. Sign in, open Panels and choose Add. Do not send credentials in chat.
adm_nav_addpanel_no_web:
🖥 Add panel
Set PUBLIC_URL to the shop’s secure public address to enable the web form. Do not send panel credentials in chat.
adm_nav_updates_text:
🆕 Bot updates
Make a backup first. Version status, updates and rollback are available in the web panel. Execution requires the enabled host agent and backup-management permission. Pressing this button never starts an update.
adm_nav_updates_no_web:
🆕 Bot updates
Make a backup first. Set PUBLIC_URL and open Updates in the web panel for the secure update flow. This button does not execute installation or update commands.
adm_nav_guide_text:
📚 Admin guide

• Statistics: overview and period reports.
• Users: lookup, filtered lists and permitted actions on customer cards.
• Finance and receipts: reports, receipt reviews, bank cards and gateways.
• Shop setup: plans, codes and growth tools.
• Panels: view and configure service panels; add panels using the web form.
• General settings: bot appearance, schedules, health and backups.

Options follow your permissions. The full guide is available in the web panel.
adm_nav_guide_no_web:
📚 Admin guide

• Statistics: overview and period reports.
• Users: lookup, filtered lists and permitted actions on customer cards.
• Finance and receipts: reports, receipt reviews, bank cards and gateways.
• Shop setup: plans, codes and growth tools.
• Panels: view and configure service panels; add panels using the web form.
• General settings: bot appearance, schedules, health and backups.

Options follow your permissions. Set PUBLIC_URL to enable the web guide.
